title: AI cross-task working memory: accumulate analysis context across all tasks in an engagement for compound reasoning
goal: AutoPenBench's agent maintains working memory across all steps in a task chain. AegisPT's ai_agent.py runs per-task analysis but _build_analysis_context() only includes findings from the current run (capped at 25, line 742). Prior task analyses, proposals, and reasoning are NOT fed into subsequent task analyses. This prevents compound reasoning. Fix: Extend _build_analysis_context() to include: (1) Prior task analyses for the engagement: last 5 AgentReasoning records for the engagement (summary_text, hypotheses, confirmed_proposals). (2) Prior approved proposals and their outcomes: which proposals were approved, which found vulnerabilities. (3) Engagement-level finding summary: critical/high findings already discovered, targets already enumerated. (4) Running 'attack narrative': a short (5-sentence) rolling summary of the engagement's security story so far, updated after each task. This matches AutoPenBench's Summary procedure which 'condenses task history to reduce hallucinations'. Implementation: in ai_agent.py _build_analysis_context(), add an 'engagement_context' section. Load the last 5 AgentReasoning records for the engagement. Load the engagement-level finding count by severity. Generate attack_narrative by calling a lightweight summarization prompt. Cap total context to avoid token limits.
scope: AutoPenBench code audit: _build_analysis_context() line 742 only passes run.findings[:25] — no prior task analysis, no approved proposals, no engagement narrative. AutoPenBench shows this working memory is what enables compound reasoning and 64% assisted agent success.
generation_reason: AI agent analyzes each task in isolation — no memory of prior analyses. AutoPenBench's working memory is the key enabler of compound reasoning. Must be added to reach 60%+ effective AI guidance.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Extend _build_analysis_context() only. Do not change proposal generation, approval gates, or AI provider connections. Keep total context within 8000 tokens.

success_criteria: _build_analysis_context() includes last 5 AgentReasoning summaries for the engagement.
Context includes approved proposals and their finding outcomes.
A rolling attack_narrative field is generated and updated per task analysis.
Total context capped to prevent token limit issues.
AI proposals after the change demonstrate awareness of prior task results (test on engagement with 3+ completed tasks).
No regression in AI agent tests.
